value.rationale: PASS. For a physically canonical finite-N threshold-resetting gas, the stationary law exists at N=3, but means need N>=4, variances need N>=5 and fourth moments need N>=7. This directly limits standard covariance/fourth-moment observables used in the source and quantifies the strength of simultaneous extreme excursions and their age mechanism. The full natural threshold family and sharp exponents are more informative than a routine sample computation or arbitrary parameter restriction.
